crossRefs.note: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”
“Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
“ ‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am Yahweh your God.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect: not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.
So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any…
“ ‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am Yahweh.
Bathsheba therefore went to king Solomon, to speak to him for Adonijah. The king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself…
Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
“ ‘If a woman has a discharge, and her discharge in her flesh is blood, she shall be in her impurity seven days.…

translations.web: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.
translations.bsb: Rachel said to her father, “Sir, do not be angry that I cannot stand up before you; for I am having my period.” So Laban searched but could not find the household idols.
translations.kjv: And she said to her father, Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee; for the custom of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the images.
translations.asv: And she said to her father, Let not my lord be angry that I cannot rise up before thee; for the manner of women is upon me. And he searched, but found not the teraphim.
